{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Fine-knit merino turtleneck, slim fit, hip length, deep teal blue (#2F5D6B), soft wool
Tailored trousers, straight leg, full ankle length, charcoal (#3A3D42), wool-blend flannel
Wide leather belt, slim, matte black (#1E1B1E), smooth leather
Long wool coat, single-breasted, knee-to-mid-calf length, camel (#B98E5F), dense wool with a brushed finish
Insulated ankle boots, low block heel, waterproof with a grippy rubber sole, black (#1E1B1E), treated leather
Thick knitted scarf, long, soft grey (#B8B8BC), wool-cashmere blend
Knitted gloves, snug, charcoal (#3A3D42), wool lined with fleece
Structured tote, medium size, black (#1E1B1E), water-resistant coated leather

This outfit suits a neat workplace in frost and snow: a refined knit with trousers is exactly the business-neat register, and the warm coat, scarf and gloves cover a 20-minute walk in the cold. The boots have a waterproof, grippy sole for snow and road salt, and the full-length trousers sit just above the boot so the hems stay clear of slush. The deep teal picks up the cool blue of her eyes and stands out against her fair skin and dark hair, while the camel coat adds warmth over the cool charcoal and grey. The coated tote and treated leather boots wipe clean easily after salt and wet snow."}
